data.name: Benefits helper
data.description: Explains your benefits, including the company car scheme, and when you can join each one.

examples: Can I get a company car?
How does the car scheme work?
Am I eligible for a car?
intents.answer: The company car scheme is open from your first day. You choose an electric car from the approved list and the cost comes out of your salary before tax. Your benefits pack has the list and the monthly costs.
You join the pension scheme automatically in your first month. You can change how much you put in at any time.

examples: When can I choose my benefits?
intents.answer: You can choose your benefits in your first 30 days. After that, changes open once a year.

data.name: Handover agent
data.description: Passes your question to a person when the other agents cannot help. Opens a chat with your Line Manager in Teams (simulated).

examples: Can I talk to a person?
I want to speak to someone
intents.answer: I have passed your question to your Line Manager. They will reply in Teams, usually within one working day.

data.name: IT setup helper
data.description: Tracks your device and system access, and explains what happens on your first login. Checks your requests in ServiceNow.

intents.answer: Your device request is open in ServiceNow. Devices are usually delivered three to five working days before your start date, and you will get a tracking link by email.

examples: How do I log in on my first day?
How do I set up my account?
intents.answer: On your first morning, your Line Manager gives you a one-time code. Use it to sign in and choose your own password. IT will never ask you for your password.

examples: How do I get access to a system?
I need access to a tool
intents.answer: Access for your role is requested for you before you start. If something is missing, ask your Line Manager to raise a request in ServiceNow.

data.name: Merch helper
data.description: Helps with your uniform order: sizes, delivery and swaps.

intents.answer: Uniform orders go out within five working days of choosing your size. It is delivered to your branch, ready for your first day.

examples: Can I change my uniform size?
intents.answer: Yes. Tell your Line Manager in your first week and a new size will be sent to your branch at no cost.

data.name: Payroll helper
data.description: Answers questions about pay day, payslips and the bank details we need to pay you.

examples: When is my first salary paid?
intents.answer: You are paid on the last working day of each month. If you start after the 15th, your first pay comes at the end of the following month and includes the days you have worked.

examples: Where can I see my payslip?
How do I find my payslip?
intents.answer: Your payslip appears in Workday two days before pay day. You will get a notification when it is ready.

examples: How do I change my bank details?
Where do I give my bank account details?
intents.answer: Use the Payroll Journey to give or update your bank details. We pass them straight to the payroll system and do not keep them here.

data.name: Vetting progress helper
data.description: Explains where your pre-employment checks are and how long they usually take.

intents.answer: Your checks are with our vetting partner. Most finish within two to three weeks. There is nothing you need to do unless we contact you.

examples: Why are my checks taking so long?
intents.answer: Some checks take longer, often while a past employer replies. That is normal. If your start date needs to move, HR will tell you first and agree a new date with you.

examples: What documents do I need for right to work?
intents.answer: A valid passport is the simplest. The Pre-employment checks Journey lists the other documents we can accept.

data.name: Your first weeks helper
data.description: Answers everyday questions about your first day and first weeks: where to go, who you will meet and what to expect.

examples: What happens on my first day?
Where do I go on day one?
intents.answer: Arrive at 9am and ask for your Line Manager at reception. Your first morning is a welcome, your device and meeting your team.
Wear what you would for a client meeting on your first day. After that, follow what your team does.
Your buddy is a colleague who has been here a while. They are there for the small questions, and will say hello before you start.
